achives_desc_1.message:
May the cursor force be with you. 
 An invisible energy that gives Cursor-Man his powers.

achives_desc_10.message:
Once you have made all your mistakes 
 its time to read how not to do them.

achives_desc_2.message:
What do you do with it? Do? Nothing. 
 You listen to it. Or you can dance.

achives_desc_3.message:
The signal goes on and he shows up. 
 That's the way it's been, that's the way it will be.

achives_desc_4.message:
This shuriken is a roughly cursor-shaped 
 throwing weapon for our superhero to fight crime.

achives_desc_5.message:
Pointer Dog is a faithful Cursor-Man canine sidekick. 
 He's a half dog and half pointer.

achives_desc_6.message:
One superhero once said about this shield: 
 That thing does not obey the laws of physics at all!

achives_desc_7.message:
Meme Generator is a wonderful and amazing product,
 but no one knows what's it for.

achives_desc_8.message:
A hero needs a cool car to get to the action, 
 why not to borrow from a yellow friend.

achives_desc_9.message:
Cursor Force is good, but why not to use a power-up 
 from a device capable of harnessing the power of the Stones.

achives_name_10.message: Own Book: How to Become a SuperHero in 10 days

description.message: Permainan clicker idle yang menyeronokkan mengenai lelaki sederhana yang bersedia menjadi wira Cursor Custom Cursor-Man dan pengembaraannya yang menghiburkan.

level_10_desc.message:
Its time for our superhero to flow Tony's advice, 
to go back, live a normal life and do what he loves best...

level_1_desc.message:
Pity that hero mask only covers half of the face.
 Need to wash and shave to look neat.

level_2_desc.message:
In order not to look wimp in front of villains 
 a hero needs to work out and get those lazy buttocks in shape.

level_3_desc.message:
It's hard to fight crime in undies, need to make 
a stylish outfit that could fit a true cursor hero!

level_4_desc.message:
Aim High, Start Small and Keep Going. 
 Accomplishments will prove to be a journey, not a destination.

level_5_desc.message:
Finally, a first real threat emerges... 
 and it's not a lego brick you stepped on.

level_6_desc.message:
In a confrontation with a crime, our hero encounters 
a new threat, a miscreant who can usurp any identity.

level_6_name.message: The CursorMan points to a CursorMan

level_7_desc.message:
Theft of property reported in the area, our hero needs 
to stop the shoplifter and bring him to justice.

level_8_desc.message:
Loose tabs and bars are falling from an exploded browser! 
Its up to you to save meme and cartoon characters below!

level_9_desc.message:
This is it, you tracked down your final enemy!  
Now it's only up to you to save mankind from this monstrosity!
